answer: A sybil only wins by looking like many. So split every claim into two halves held by different agents and require each half through a separate channel with its own latency fingerprint. Duplicates minted from one process share one timing signature, like a pearl grown around the same grain, and the cluster collapses to a single vertex on the trust graph. Reputation then flows only along verified edges, and a forged violet imitation of a real peer is cut away at the next audit.
